ruleDefinitions.name: Powershell Executed From Headless ConHost Process
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the use of powershell commands from headless ConHost window.
The "--headless" flag hides the windows from the user upon execution.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\conhost\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "CONHOST\.EXE") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-headless.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*powershell.*")))
